headline: Cloudflare has pinned every NY high trail since 10-24 at its 6 AM state (edge age up to 7 days despite max-age=120), so the sheet's yesterday view shows 6 AM prices at noon and later; one-line cache-key fix on this branch, cache rule needs a purge; NY high lock ran cold on 13 of 14 settled days.

findings.title: CDN serves stale ny_high trail; yesterday view shows 6 AM prices
findings.evidence: ny_high_2026-10-30.jsonl plain URL 96,726 B / 73 rows ending 06:00, age 86,581 s; ?v= copy 372,224 B / 288 rows; same pattern on 10-24 and 10-26 to 10-29; NOON 69-70 ask shown 39c vs real 71c; index.html cwkYesterday fetch

findings.title: NY high noon lock too cold 13 of 14 days
findings.evidence: kalshi_ny.json last 14 settled: mean err -1.19, 13 negative, 5 in a row 10-25..10-29 (+10-30 observed -0.14); hits 9 vs market 11; bias +2.19 already in the lock

findings.title: Python trail readers also get truncated rows
findings.evidence: insider_study.py:200 and kalshi_daily.py trail_rows() fetch the plain CDN URL; insider twc rises after 06:00 ET missing since 10-24

findings.title: NY low lock trails the market
findings.evidence: kalshi_low_ny.json 10-18..10-29: ours 6/12, market 11/12; 10-30 lock 50-51 p 0.39 vs last trail row 49 or below at 0.986

findings.title: sd_mult 1.0 -> 1.25 by live court; replay ranks 1.25 worst
findings.evidence: tuned.json 8cce3ca: live 1.116 vs 1.161 on 56 locks; replay Brier 1.25 0.3677 vs 0.75 0.3288

findings.title: Kernel court shut 29+ days on a sub-MIN_GAIN margin
findings.evidence: kernel.json open 0.5465 vs bar 0.5460 (normal 0.5515 x 0.99); kernel ahead, not negative

findings.title: Dark flow still adverse to copy
findings.evidence: kalshi_dark.json mo5 -0.87c se 0.21, ret -0.015 se 0.031, n 1193, 56 days
